svg.title: What we'll make: a four-line card on how your assistant works
svg.desc: A card titled How my assistant works. Line 1: It predicts the next words. Fluent is not the same as true. Line 2: Its knowledge stops at a date unless it searches. Look for sources. Line 3: It only sees this chat. In long chats, repeat key facts. Line 4: A new chat starts blank, except what memory adds.

g.text: Its knowledge stops at a date, unless it searches.
It only sees what is in this chat.
A new chat starts blank, except what memory adds.
Fluent is not the same as true. Check names and numbers.
For anything recent, look for sources.
In long chats, repeat the key facts.
Give it your facts again each time.
